entities.name: PMID:27496649
observations: 2016 Journal of Thoracic Oncology observational molecular-pathology study of 278 resected lung adenocarcinomas.
Histologic classification used 2011 IASLC/ATS/ERS and 2015 WHO frameworks; tumors underwent mutation testing and qRT-PCR against paired normal lung.
Lineage panel included NKX2-1, GATA6, FOXJ1, SPDEF, ID2, POU5F1, SOX2, and MYC.

Lineage-gene expression differed across histologic and mutation-defined groups; NKX2-1, GATA6, FOXJ1, and POU5F1 showed linear relationships across histologic subgroups independent of mutation status.
Evidence supports group-level lineage-background discrimination, but not a validated classifier or proof that each histologic pattern has an exclusive cell of origin.
Abstract-level evidence did not directly test terminal respiratory unit, bronchiolar, alveolar type II, or club-cell ancestry by lineage tracing or single-cell methods.
